Name: Baanah, Father of Heleb
Summary: Baanah the Netophathite is named as the father of Heleb, one of David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Baanah son of Rimmon, who murdered Ish-bosheth.
KeyStory: Baanah the Netophathite fathered one of David's thirty.
LifeLesson: A father's name can belong to a warrior's house, not a murderer's.
